description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tribal Forcemage, adding {C}{C}.
Tribal Forcemage dies, triggering Yedora, returning Tribal Forcemage to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Activate Tribal Forcemage by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Tribal Forcemage's megamorph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tribal Forcemage triggers, giving all creatures you control of a chosen creature type +2/+2 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat.
